'''Lourdes Vega Fernández''' ([[Villanueva del Fresno]], [[Badajoz]], 1965) is a [[Spaniards|Spanish]] scientist, specialist on molecular thermodynamics, clean energy and sustainable products, focused on [[Carbon capture and storage|CO2 capture]] and utilization, hydrogen production, storage, transportation and utilization, sustainable cooling systems, and [[water treatment]].<ref name="kulv"/>

== Academic and research information ==
Vega has a Ph.D. in Theorical Physics from the [[University of Seville]] (Spain) and she is a professor in [[Khalifa University]] (Abu Dhabi, UAE) at the Chemical Engineering department.<ref name="kulv">{{Cite web |title=Dr. Lourdes Vega |url=https://www.ku.ac.ae/academics/college-of-engineering/department/department-of-chemical-engineering/people/dr-lourdes-f-vega |website=Khalifa University |language=en}}</ref>

She is an expert in [[Molecular Modelling|molecular modeling]] and her research in models to predict the thermodynamical behaviour of chemical compounds and the development of new materials to separate gases and contaminants led to a large number of scientific publication in high-impact journals.{{Citation needed|date=January 2024}}

Vega was a professor of Chemical Engineering at the [[University of Rovira i Virgili]] between 1995 and 2003. Later, she joined the [[Spanish National Research Council]]'s Institute of Material Science of Barcelona (ICMAB).<ref name="kulv"/>

In 2017, Vega entered the Academy of Sciences of Granada<ref>{{Cite news |last=Lorca |first=Noelia S. |title=La doctora Lourdes Vega Fernández ingresa en la Academia de las Ciencias de Granada |url=https://www.ahoragranada.com/noticias/la-doctora-lourdes-vega-fernandez-ingresa-en-la-academia-de-las-ciencias-de-granada/ |access-date=2020-11-11 |website=Ahora Granada |language=es}}</ref> She is also an elected member of the Mohammed bin Rashid Academy of Scientists<ref>{{Cite news |title=Mohammed bin Rashid Academy of Scientists |url=https://mbras.ae/en/members#lourdes-f-vega |access-date=2021-09-18 |website=mbras.ae}}</ref>

Vega was Global Director of Technology in Agro-Food, Water Treatment and CO<sub>2</sub> Uses of [[Air Products]], combining that position with that of director of R&D of Carburos Metálicos S.A., and with the direction of the MATGAS R&D center at the [[Autonomous University of Barcelona]]. Since 2016 she directs Khalifa University's Research and Development Center for Carbon Dioxide and Hydrogen (RICH).<ref>{{Cite news |title=Lourdes Vega, la física que transforma el CO<sub>2</sub> en millones de euros |url=https://raex.es/index.php/actividades/2262-lourdes-vega-la-fisica-que-transforma-el-co2-en-millones-de-euros.html |access-date=2020-11-16 |website=raex.es |language=es-es}}</ref><ref name="kulv"/>

== Merits, recognitions and distinctions ==
She received the Physics, Innovation and Technology Award in 2013 for “the outstanding, original and creative way in which she has managed to bring theoretical and computational research in statistical physics, a branch of basic physics, to the industrial world.”<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |title=Lourdes Vega |url=https://www.fbbva.es/galardonados/lourdes-vega/ |access-date=2020-11-11 |website=FBBVA |language=es}}</ref>

She was awarded the United Arab Emirates Medal for Scientific Excellence in 2020 for her work ''Science for Sustainable Products''. She is the first non-Arab person to achieve this distinction<ref>{{Cite news |date=2020-02-05 |title=La española Lourdes Vega, primera persona no árabe que logra la Medalla a la Excelencia Científica de Emiratos |url=https://elcorreo.ae/emiratos/espanola-lourdes-vega-primera-mujer-no-arabe-que-logra-medalla-excelencia-cientifica |access-date=2020-11-11 |website=EL CORREO DEL GOLFO |language=es}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |date=2020-02-07 |title=La villanovense Lourdes Vega recibe la Medalla a la Excelencia Científica de Emiratos Árabes |url=https://www.hoy.es/prov-badajoz/villanovense-lourdes-vega-20200207002726-ntvo.html |access-date=2020-11-11 |website=Hoy |language=es}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |date=2020-09-08 |title=Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid announces scientific medal winners |url=https://www.thenationalnews.com/uae/science/sheikh-mohammed-bin-rashid-announces-scientific-medal-winners-1.974187 |access-date=2024-01-14 |website=thenationalnews.com |language=en}}</ref>

The [[American Institute of Chemical Engineers]] elected her as a fellow in 2022.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2022-01-19 |title=
Introducing Some of AIChE's Recently Elected Fellows |url=https://www.aiche.org/chenected/2022/01/introducing-some-aiches-recently-elected-fellows |access-date=2024-01-14 |website=AIChE |language=en}}</ref> In 2023, Vega entered the [[Spanish Royal Academy of Sciences]] as a corresponding member.<ref>{{Cite news |last=PARRA |first=ALMUDENA |date=2023-12-20 |title=La Doctora Lourdes Vega ingresa en la Real Academia de Ciencias de España |url=https://villanuevadelfresno.hoy.es/doctora-lourdes-vega-ingresa-real-academia-ciencias-20231220204028-nt.html |access-date=2024-01-13 |website=Hoy |language=es}}</ref>

She has published more than 370 scientific articles,<ref>{{Cite web |date=2024-01-14 |title=Google Scholar Citations |url=https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=RUesAz0AAAAJ |access-date=2024-01-14 |website=Google Scholar |language=en}}</ref> has 5 patents, and is the author of the popular book on the uses of CO<sub>2</sub>, whose title is ''CO2 as a resource. From capture to industrial uses''.<ref name=":0"/><ref>{{Cite web |title=Protectia. transferencia Tecnológica |url=https://www.protectia.eu/2015/07/lourdes-vega-transferencia-tecnologia/}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Se presenta un nuevo libro sobre el CO<sub>2</sub> y su uso en favor de la sostenibilidad |url=https://www.interempresas.net/Energia/Articulos/41586-Se-presenta-un-nuevo-libro-sobre-el-CO2-y-su-uso-en-favor-de-la-sostenibilidad.html |access-date=2020-11-16 |website=Interempresas |language=es}}</ref>

Vega is a member of the boards of directors of the chemical company Ercros and water services company [[Canal de Isabel II]]<ref>{{Cite web |title=Lourdes Vega |url=https://www.ercros.es/en/company/management-team/lourdes-vega-fernandez}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Jaime García-Legaz entra en el consejo del Canal de Isabel II como independiente |url=https://cincodias.elpais.com/cincodias/2020/11/25/companias/1606334058_326789.html |website=El País |date=25 November 2020 |language=es}}</ref>
